items.en: Chinese Tor-M1 derivative HQ-17 spotted in Algerian camouflage colours
items.nl: Chinese Tor-M1-afgeleide HQ-17 gespot in Algerijnse camouflagekleuren
items.sEn: Photos circulating on Chinese social media (Weibo) show a Chinese HQ-17 short-range air defence system painted in a camouflage pattern matching Chinese-made vehicles already in Algerian service, Defence Blog reports. Chinese sources claim the system is headed to Algeria; an OSINT account that flagged the photos noted…

items.en: Turkey Reportedly Eyes Egypt as S-400 Buyer to Resolve F-35 Impasse; Cairo Already Fields Russian S-300VM
items.nl: Turkije zou Egypte als koper van S-400's overwegen om F-35-impasse op te lossen; Caïro heeft al Russische S-300VM
items.sEn: Defense Express (author Ivan Kyrychevskiy) reports that Turkey is still seeking a buyer for its Russian S-400 air defense systems, acquired under a 2017 contract with Moscow and the direct cause of Turkey's exclusion from the US F-35 program. Egypt has reportedly emerged as a probable buyer, with talks said to have ta…
